text: Diagon Alley. We're fortunate to have
someone like him nearby. Mr. Ollivander
is a genuine craftsman and highly
skilled wand maker. I would trust no one
else to pair me with a wand.
What? I'm eager to get to Hogsmeat. Very
well. I'd like you to make your first
visit to the village with a classmate.
Help you get your bearings. Perhaps
Sebastian Salo or Natsai Onai. I've
noticed you spending time with them.
Okay. Who should we choose?
Uh Nati. I'd like to go with Natty.
Excellent choice. Miss Onai is one of
our most talented students. and she
knows the area. She'll keep you well
clear of any of Victor Rookwood's
undesirabs on route. Rookwood, a rather
unsavory local. Best to avoid him and
his associates, including his right hand
of sorts, Theophilus Harlow, if you can.
